pages.text: Use the menu to deposit or withdraw experience. For a quick test, store one level’s worth and withdraw it again. Use the all-XP buttons to move a full balance before or after a trip.

The XP Obelisk stores experience as XP Juice. A fluid line can bring juice from an $(l:enderio:machines/collection)XP Vacuum$(/l) or feed a $(l:enderio:machines/tanks)Fluid Tank$(/l). Set the fluid faces and give the line room to transfer.
A tank can turn 250 mB of stored XP Juice and a Glass Bottle into a Bottle o’ Enchanting. You can also carry experience in a $(l:enderio:souls/vials)Void Vial$(/l).
